simple.summary: אֶלְתְּקֹן (ʼEltᵉqôn) means Eltekon , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 15 59.

definitions.full: H515. Elteqon אֶלְתְּקן proper name, of a location a city in the tribe of Judah north of Hebron Josh 15:59 .
